title: So far, incredible 👌
body:
Wow, just WOW. The developers have thought about everything in this app, and integrate it all together to create a seamless, intuitive and productive interface and functionality. I have been waiting a long time for an app like this, and so delighted it’s here 😀 Already seeing an improvement to my life, and it’s only been a few days. What I’d like to see in future updates:

1. Ability to set reminders for tasks for the previous day, not just the same day. 
2. A wider range of icons
3. Different view types of habits
4. More satisfying response when a habit is long held and completed I.e. pop, sparkles or something. 
5. A trophy for completing all your habits for the day.
6. Ability to quick hide the tasks aspect, so you can just focus on habits until you want to see your todo list for the day (being slapped with that at 5.30am can be a bit much!)
7. Sync (not just share) tasks with another person I.e family member

I hope to see these improvements in the future, but even without them this app is a game changer for me 😀

Thanks again developers 👍

title: Love this app
body:
I love this app, it’s really improved my productivity. I’ve even bought the lifetime premium! However, there are 3 areas I would suggest for improvement:

1) Sometimes when I use the mini keyboard on my iPad the app glitches out and doesn’t allow me to add the task I’ve started typing so I have to either switch to the regular sized keyboard or close the app and reopen it. 

2) I use auto light/dark theme on my iPad and iPhone but at the moment I don’t believe there is an option for auto theme within this app. Considering there is a light and dark theme it would be nice to be able to use those in conjuncture with auto theme. 

3) It would be really cool if you could consider adding an Apple Watch app in the future. Being able to view the tasks and habits I have left todo today on my wrist would be really useful and definitely further boost productivity. 

I really do love this app, hence the 5 stars but those are definitely potential improvements that could make it even better!

I’ve worked my way through so many productivity apps and this one is by far the best, it keeps everything in one place and organises it in a neat and clear way. 

The only feature I’d like to see would be to set a goal to do a habit so many times a week rather than on set days, e.g. I want to run 3 times per week but not on specific days. Other than that, I could not recommend this app more!

title: This app is exactly what I was looking for!
body:
It is simple, beautiful, easy and fun to use. It keeps me on track with my habits (8hrs sleep, meditation, drinking water, etc) and organises my tasks in a bite size way (today, tomorrow, this week) — both these functions feature in the “home” section and gives a good visual overview of where I am in my day. 
The app itself isn’t too expensive (in fact perfectly priced) and offers a free 7 day trial. It also isn’t too complicated with too many unnecessary features. 
When my trial runs out, I am upgrading to the lifetime premium option 😎 
I have previously tried 5-10 other apps within this same category (incl. todoist, done, wunderlist, etc) and this one is my favourite so far!

title: Giving it 3 stars because of good service...read on
body:
I found this app amazing really, it is user friendly, clean, it targets, habits, tasks, reminders and calendar and therefore keeps information all in one place. I would like to see it add more features similar to promodoro or like timerlogger and my favourite discontinued 30/30 which serves as a end time prediction is well. A person can dream!

Everything was going great but so far the app does not sync with my phone, I have the same Apple ID on both devices, can see the purchase on both and this the reason I gave this 3 stars and not one is because the customer service is where this team excels. They have been trying to check for a few days what is going on and their best to assist. 

They should clarify that the monthly subscription and forever product will work differently. 

It is very annoying that things are not transferring from my iPad to my phone, but as I said they are working on it and I do like the app, however, I did purchase it for the synch capabilities.

title: Simple but Effective
body:
I’ve tried every task manager out there, but I’ve never been able to stick with one. Tappsk is simple, but so far it’s been working well. 

I love the home screen which integrates habits and tasks  I’m also regularly using the voice input to dictate tasks. 

It’s missing a few features that would make it perfect: a way to get tasks into it more easily, a share extension or maybe an interface to Siri Shortcuts would be awesome. 

That said, I was impressed enough to buy the lifetime premium within a week so looking forward to seeing how the app develops.
